race.comment: Tricky little staying race. FOIRE DE TRONE (9) was a solid winner over 2100m two back before a good effort up in grade at Caulfield where Belle Savoir gapped the field. The form in behind has stood up nicely and she looks primed getting to 2400m now with Jabez Johnstone sticking from a soft gate. EMPRESS OF THE SUN (8) is the danger. She's been sent out favourite her past couple behind the in-form Nearco Frod, just fair to the line here last time. Gets a senior on and will be up on speed which is key. CUSTOMER SERVICE (7) brings the Nearco Frod form as well. He's consistent and there isn't much between the top three as we've seen a few times now. He maps well. ANT (10) needs to find his best now but it would be good enough. The run two back was solid and 2400m should suit now.
